steps.title: Load the quarter's filings
steps.prose: One row per filing: client, registrant, reported spend, and one line on what the filing asked for. Invented data, engineered short so the comparison is easy to see; no real filing.
steps.data_description: Every filing in the sample, as the CSV records it.

steps.title: Load what each client said in public
steps.prose: One row per organisation: one line of what it committed to publicly, and where it said it. Also invented. Check it really is one row per organisation — the join fails on a repeat.
steps.data_description: Every organisation with a public commitment on record.

steps.title: Keep the filings above $50,000
steps.prose: Drops filings under $50,000; exactly $50,000 is kept. The threshold is an editorial choice — check it is the line you would draw, because everything under it leaves here.
steps.data_description: Filings reporting at least $50,000; each drop is recorded.

steps.title: Join each filing to its client's commitment
steps.prose: A left join on client name, so no filing is dropped. A filing with no matching commitment survives with the field blank — that blank is the join's record of a non-match, not missing data.
steps.data_description: Every surviving filing, plus its client's commitment where one matched.

steps.title: Read the two texts against each other
steps.prose: A model reads the commitment and the ask together and answers Contradicts, Matches, Unclear or No commitment given. Check each against both texts; it is the weakest link.
steps.data_description: The same filings, plus the model's judgment and its one-sentence note.

steps.title: Flag the contradictions
steps.prose: Flags a filing only where a commitment was joined onto it and the model said Contradicts. Plain code, so a wrong flag traces to a wrong judgment, and a blank commitment never becomes one.

steps.title: Publish the report
steps.prose: One HTML page: spend, the ask, the commitment or that none is on record, and for a flagged filing both texts together. Check the contradiction reads as one from those two texts alone.
steps.data_description: One row per surviving filing, as published.
